title: Ornith Releases 122B Open Weight Model for Single NVIDIA DGX Card
summary:
A new open weight large language model offers frontier level capabilities with an emphasis on exceptional inference efficiency. Released by Ornith as Ornith-1.5-122B, the system utilizes the MIT license and can execute on a single NVIDIA DGX card. The model scored 0.845 on the SWE-bench Verified benchmark, 0.813 on TB2.1, and 0.800 on CyberGym to demonstrate its proficiency in coding and agentic tasks.

The model is available on Hugging Face in FP8, NVFP4, GGUF, and MLX formats to support local deployment via Ollama, Hermes Agent, and AtomicChat. Osaurus integrated the model on launch day for Mac users without requiring cloud subscriptions, and AtomicChat published a quantization ladder that reduces memory requirements from 132.6GB to 35.0GB for use on 64GB Macs. The ecosystem also includes Unsloth for fine-tuning and RunInfra for API integration.

selectedTweets.bestBit: released FP8, NVFP4, GGUF, and MLX variants of the Ornith 1.5 122B model
selectedTweets.text:
To help everyone adopt advanced intelligence and empower everyday tasks, we also released FP8, NVFP4, GGUF, and MLX variants of the Ornith 1.5 122B model.  

You can easily run them on  @ollama Ollama, @NousResearch  Hermes Agent,  and  @atomic_chat_hq AtomicChat.  

With  @UnslothAI  Unsloth, you can easily fine-tune Ornith to fit your own use cases. We look forward to seeing more projects/model variants built on Ornith.  

Ornith 1.5 122B model will be avilable on RunInfra @runinfrai, you can easily integrate the model to you workflows via API.   

You can also build with Ornith using @opencode  OpenCode and @CommandCodeAI Command Code.   

@inco_ai Inco provides the most advanced DFlash2 draft model to empower inference.  

SGLang @radixark serves the model locally, or you can easily deploy it on GPUs.    

All models are open-weighted on Hugging Face  @huggingface .  

We're happy to be part of the open-weight community. We believe everyone should have the right to control intelligence, protect their data, and shape how AI works for them.
